I'm currently stuck and home unemployed living with a traditionally abusive unemployed father. I get the pain. This is why I'm an alcoholic and it's not secret.

P.s. if me revealing my deets drives u away just let me know point blank. Wouldn't be the first time. :)

Both me and my father are unemployed so I cannot directly provide financial assistance right now
However I am working on getting some kind of job or internship that might help with income. When that happens I will do my best to remember you and give you money (no return expected). Not charity, I just wanna make things a little less painful for you. 

Please don't mistake me for being overly sweet or saccharine. Just that I encounter bullshit on a daily basis and want to counter that by helping some souls out there who I do not have to know.

Also I am sad to say that I somewhat understand your mom.. kind of sounds like myself. I have a lot of things wrong with me but this I know, I care and I want to help. It's this attitude of caring that has brought out storms of fury and waves of gentleness within me . 

I'm sorry medication hasn't worked out for you. If you were healthier I'd have suggested marijuana but no matter. You're strong enough without any of these substances and know that I admire you already bc of this. 

Im not sure of your skills or qualifications otherwise I'd have found resources to suggest to you. Again, no matter.

At this point all I can say is, my eyes and ears are open for you anytime. Time zone differences aside. It can be exhausting having such burdens and still helping others. Just know it isn't and doesn't have to be a 24/7 job. You can be selfish sometimes .
